$Comment: Torch secondary. AllowIndefiniteHold is false with a single 5.0 threshold, so ChargingInteraction.simulateTick0 finishes the charge by itself at 5s and jumps to the Next entry below. Only the >=5s path exists, so a shorter charge runs nothing.

5.0.$Comment: Ignition step. Raycast Distance caps how far wood can be lit at 4 blocks and BlockTag keeps it to Type=Wood, replacing the previous distance-less BlockCondition. When no block candidate is selected the HitBlock below is never forked, so nothing ignites and no torch is spent.

Interactions.$Comment: Place Fire on the in-range wood block the raycast selected. RemoveItemInHand is false because consumption is done explicitly below, after the ignition.
Bookkeeping tail of the ignition: the torch is spent. AdjustHeldItemQuantity is negative so ModifyInventory removes from the held slot, which for a Secondary input is the hotbar torch.
